_source: Plant hire (CAT-13, wet hire) and site services (CAT-14) — Agent model, PLANT_HIRE_CATALOGUE.md. Customer price = the partner's written rate x 1.12 (12% commission). No rate is published until at least two partners' written rate cards exist for a SKU in a province (services/pricing/ratecards/load_rate_cards.py writes 'rates'); until then everything is quoted. Monthly and long-term hire, demolition and scheduled waste contracts are always quoted.
